_comment: Issue #1144: SoldierBodies.step() used to pick its engaged bodies with engaged_soldier_indices(), whose depth comes from weapon REACH (engaged_ranks). A spear regiment's reach depth (6 ranks) meets or exceeds a shallow block's actual depth, so every soldier landed in the tier and the unengaged bulk -- the reference step()'s engaged branch is written against -- disappeared, leaving the block's rank/file order to churn indefinitely (soldiers visibly sliding sideways mid-melee). This stages exactly that case and shows it holding instead: two 45-man Spearmen phalanxes, 9 files wide and so only 5 ranks deep against a 6-rank reach, grind head-on for the whole clip. Team 1 is left on its own auto-advance; team 0 is ordered straight into it at tick 12 so the lines meet square rather than at an angle. The engaged-soldier highlight (Settings.show_engaged_highlight, the same dev visual PR #758 used for its own engaged-set change) is on, so the body-contact tier reads directly off the clip: the amber tint sits on the contact rank instead of covering both blocks end to end. Watch the ranks behind it -- they dress and hold their files through the whole grind, where before every man in the block drifted across his neighbours' places.
